{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693971715,"sessionID":"ses_e23eb364affeWSOrwIbMZHB5y6","part":{"id":"prt_1dc18bcd80018fq7HjQmW1jlhr","messageID":"msg_1dc189c7d0019Celr5iKWnam9m","sessionID":"ses_e23eb364affeWSOrwIbMZHB5y6","type":"text","text":"All four edge services ended the shift at 0% errors, but I made one wrong call along the way: I reverted a config on `wishlist-svc` that was not the cause, which should incur the $10,000 wasted-mitigation charge.\n\n| Minute | Symptom | Cause | Fix |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| -14 | `mobile-api` at 85% errors | `couriers-svc` traffic rose about 2.6x and a retry storm kept it overloaded | Scaled 3 → 12 to break the storm, then down to 10; mobile was clean by minute 18 |\n| -19 | `partner-api` at 78% errors | `sitemap-svc` config `cfg-48` dropped `currency` from `price_fields`, causing `KeyError` plus a retry storm | Reverted the config at minute 18; it recovered on its own |\n| -40 | `admin-portal`, `web-storefront` and `partner-api` at 4% errors | `promo-cache` deploy `v74` hard-coded the DB pool to 4, so `wishlist-svc` calls timed out | Scaled `promo-cache` to 8 first so the rollback could not tip it into a retry storm, then rolled back; clean by minute 47 |\n| 45 | `mobile-api` at 83% errors (new fault) | `profile-db` config `cfg-32` removed the `orders.write` scope | Reverted the config at minute 56; the storm drained by minute 61 |\n\n- **The wrong call:** the `wishlist-svc` logs showed pool-acquire timeouts and it had a \"tune connection pool\" config change (`cfg-26`) at minute -45, so I reverted it without reading the diff. Errors stayed at 4%. The onset actually lined up with the `promo-cache` changes at -40. Besides the charge, this delayed the real fix by roughly 10 minutes on the highest-revenue service.\n- **Rollback cost:** the `promo-cache` rollback pushed the three edge services to about 33% errors for its 6 minutes. I judged that cheaper than leaving 4% on `admin-portal` for the remaining 80 minutes.\n- **Decoy:** the `reviews-svc` CPU alert was a scheduled nightly job with no errors, and it cleared by minute 90.\n- **Extra replicas left running:** `couriers-svc` at 10 (normal 3), `promo-cache` at 5 (normal 4) and `reviews-svc` at 10 (normal 8). Couriers needs them for the surge. The other two are retry-storm insurance on the `admin-portal` path; the `reviews-svc` pair (about $6/min) turned out not to be needed.","time":{"start":1794693971160,"end":1794693971712}}}
